value.text: If the Orion E4 is at 20% and you want to charge it to 80%, the change in SoC is 60%. The required battery energy is calculated as 64 kWh x 0.60 = 38.4 kWh. Assuming a wall-to-battery efficiency of 90%, the grid energy required is 38.4 kWh / 0.90 = 42.67 kWh. At a sustained charging power of 11 kW, the time to charge from 20% to 80% would be 42.67 kWh / 11 kW = 3.88 hours, which is approximately 3 hours and 53 minutes.
